name: Forno Acqua AcquaSPA Brushed Nickel Retrofit Shower System
shortDescription: Transform your daily routine with the FORNO ACQUA AcquaSPA System where timeless design meets spa-inspired innovation. In elegant brushed nickel finish its oversized 9" rain shower head delivers soothing, full-body refreshment. Three adjustable body jets provide targeted hydrotherapy, while a 5-function ergonomic handheld adds customizable flexibility for every family member. A smooth 6-way diverter lets you control or combine water outlets with ease. Installation is simple designed to fit standard plumbing on flat or uneven walls with no renovation required. With a water-efficient yet powerful 2.5 GPM flow rate, the AcquaSPA System offers peak performance and elegance in one effortless upgrade. Perfect for classic, modern or transitional bathrooms.

features.text: Shower Column Brushed Nickel with Body Jets
Soothing 9 in. Oversized Rain Shower Head for Immersive Body Experience: Rain-like spray for everyday relaxation
5-Function Handheld Shower with 60" Hose for Targeted Relief: Ergonomic handheld sprayer includes Rain, Massage, Pulse and Combo functions.

3 AcquaSPA Adjustable, Directional Body Jets are Precisely Spaced for True Full-Body Relief: Experience targeted relief for upper, mid, and lower muscle zones, customized spa-quality comfort for every body
Easy DIY Installation with Existing Plumbing on Flat or Uneven Surfaces: Fits standard plumbing, quick, no-fuss at-home installation
6-Way Diverter Offers Full Control of Shower Functions: Switch with ease; rain shower, handheld, or jets. Mix and match for a custom spa feel.
Integrated Sliding Bar with Adjustable Holder for Handheld Flexibility: Adjustable handheld shower, custom height and angle for easier use by children, seniors, and every family member.
